title: Demon Slayer Canon Question Bank
adaptationBoundary: Content officially released through Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle Part 1 (the first Infinity Castle film), released in Japan on 2025-07-18 and in U.S./Canada theaters on 2025-09-12; this bank excludes any unreleased Infinity Castle film content and all manga-only material. Questions themselves draw from the released TV arcs and the released Mugen Train film.

units.title: Dedicated Fan: Mugen Train and Entertainment District
Expert: Hashira Training and Cross-Arc Canon

notes: Original wording; exactly one factual target per question; answerIndex is zero-based. Sources point to official English anime pages. The release boundary is intentionally wider than the question coverage so the bank does not include unreleased sequel-film material.

questions.prompt: What is Tanjiro Kamado doing when he returns home at the start of the anime?
questions.explanation: Tanjiro earns money by selling charcoal before finding his family attacked.

questions.prompt: Which family member survives the attack on the Kamado household but becomes a demon?
questions.explanation: Nezuko survives, but Muzan’s blood transforms her into a demon.

questions.prompt: Who becomes Tanjiro’s first formal swordsmanship and breathing trainer?
questions.explanation: The former Water Hashira Sakonji Urokodaki trains Tanjiro at Mt. Sagiri.

questions.prompt: Where does Final Selection take place?
questions.explanation: The Demon Slayer Corps holds Final Selection on Mount Fujikasane.

questions.prompt: Which breathing style does Tanjiro first use as his regular sword style?
questions.explanation: Urokodaki teaches Tanjiro Water Breathing, which he first uses in combat.

questions.prompt: In which city does Tanjiro first encounter Muzan in public?
questions.explanation: Tanjiro recognizes Muzan in Asakusa during the season-one urban encounter.

questions.prompt: What is Tamayo’s profession among humans?
questions.explanation: Tamayo operates as a doctor while seeking a way to help turn demons human.

questions.prompt: What is the main supernatural feature of Yushiro’s Blood Demon Art?
options: It hides or reveals objects and people
questions.explanation: Yushiro’s talismans enable visual concealment and revelation.

questions.prompt: What object gives Kyogai’s mansion its shifting-room effect?
questions.explanation: Kyogai rotates rooms by striking the drums embedded in his body.

questions.prompt: What animal’s head does Inosuke Hashibira wear as a mask?
questions.explanation: Inosuke’s distinctive mask is made from a boar’s head.

source.title: The Boar Bares Its Fangs, Zenitsu Sleeps

questions.prompt: What is the Kamado siblings’ surname?
questions.explanation: Tanjiro and Nezuko are the Kamado siblings.

questions.prompt: What is the principal threat on Mount Natagumo?
questions.explanation: The Natagumo mission centers on spider-themed demons and their forced family.

questions.prompt: Which rank does Rui hold among the Twelve Kizuki?
questions.explanation: Rui is Lower Rank Five of the Twelve Kizuki.

questions.prompt: What does the Demon Slayer Corps call its elite swordsmen?
questions.explanation: The Corps’ highest-ranking swordsmen are the Hashira.

questions.prompt: Who summons Tanjiro to the Hashira meeting?
questions.explanation: The Corps leader, Kagaya Ubuyashiki, presides over the Hashira meeting.

questions.prompt: Which Hashira leads the Demon Slayer mission aboard the Mugen Train?
questions.explanation: Kyojuro Rengoku is the Flame Hashira assigned to the Mugen Train mission.

source.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba—The Movie: Mugen Train

questions.prompt: What rank is Enmu when he attacks the Mugen Train?
questions.explanation: Enmu is Lower Rank One of the Twelve Kizuki.

source.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba—The Movie: Mugen Train

questions.prompt: Which Upper Rank arrives after Rengoku’s battle on the train?
questions.explanation: Akaza, Upper Rank Three, appears after the train battle.

source.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba—The Movie: Mugen Train

questions.prompt: Whose dream does Tanjiro enter while Enmu’s spell is active?
questions.explanation: Tanjiro is drawn into a dream of returning to his family before the tragedy.

source.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba—The Movie: Mugen Train

questions.prompt: What is the name of Rengoku’s signature ninth Flame Breathing form?
questions.explanation: Rengoku uses the ninth form, named Rengoku, in his final battle.

source.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba—The Movie: Mugen Train

questions.prompt: Which Hashira is assigned to investigate disappearances in the Entertainment District?
questions.explanation: The Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui leads the Entertainment District mission.

questions.prompt: What was Tengen Uzui’s former occupation?
questions.explanation: Tengen was raised as a shinobi before joining the Demon Slayer Corps.

questions.prompt: Which set lists Tengen’s three wives?
questions.explanation: Tengen’s wives are Suma, Makio, and Hinatsuru.

questions.prompt: Under what occupation does Tanjiro infiltrate the district?
options: A male attendant at a house
questions.explanation: Tanjiro is sold into service as an attendant while investigating.

questions.prompt: Which demon is publicly posing as the oiran Warabihime?
questions.explanation: Daki uses the identity of the oiran Warabihime.

questions.prompt: What is the relationship between Daki and Gyutaro?
questions.explanation: Daki and Gyutaro are brother and sister who share Upper Rank Six.

questions.prompt: What weapon does Gyutaro primarily use?
questions.explanation: Gyutaro fights with paired blood sickles coated with deadly poison.

questions.prompt: What Blood Demon Art does Nezuko use against Daki?
questions.explanation: Nezuko’s Exploding Blood ignites demon blood without harming humans.

questions.prompt: What injury permanently prevents Tengen from returning to active Hashira combat?
options: Loss of his left arm and left eye
Loss of hearing in both ears
questions.explanation: Tengen loses an arm and an eye in the Upper Six battle and retires.

questions.prompt: What does Tengen call his combat aesthetic?
questions.explanation: Tengen repeatedly frames his style and ideals around being flashy.

source.title: Things Are Gonna Get Real Flashy!

questions.prompt: Which Upper Rank attacks the Swordsmith Village alongside Gyokko?
questions.explanation: Hantengu, Upper Rank Four, is one of the two Upper Ranks sent to the village.

questions.prompt: Which Upper Rank is Gyokko?
questions.explanation: Gyokko holds Upper Rank Five.

questions.prompt: How many arms does the Yoriichi Type Zero training doll have?
questions.explanation: The doll is built with six arms to reproduce Yoriichi’s sword movements.

questions.prompt: What is Kotetsu’s role in the Swordsmith Village story?
options: He maintains the Yoriichi Type Zero doll
questions.explanation: Kotetsu is the child connected to the training doll and helps maintain it.

questions.prompt: Which weapon does Genya use in addition to a sword?
questions.explanation: Genya fights with a gun as well as a Nichirin sword.

source.title: A Sword from Over 300 Years Ago

questions.prompt: Which Hashira is the Mist Hashira?
questions.explanation: Muichiro Tokito is the Mist Hashira.

questions.prompt: Which Hashira is the Love Hashira?
questions.explanation: Mitsuri Kanroji is the Love Hashira.

questions.prompt: What is Zohakuten’s emotional source among Hantengu’s manifestations?
questions.explanation: Zohakuten is the hatred manifestation that combines the other emotion demons’ power.

questions.prompt: Which named manifestation represents joy?
questions.explanation: Urogi represents joy among Hantengu’s emotion manifestations.

questions.prompt: Which named manifestation represents anger?
questions.explanation: Sekido represents anger.

questions.prompt: What happens to Muichiro’s memories during the Swordsmith Village conflict?
questions.explanation: Muichiro regains key memories of his past as the battle progresses.

questions.prompt: Which breathing style does Mitsuri use?
questions.explanation: Mitsuri developed and uses Love Breathing.

questions.prompt: What distinctive physical change does Mitsuri reveal in her backstory?
options: Her hair became pink and green
questions.explanation: Mitsuri’s hair changed color after her unusual diet of sakura mochi.

questions.prompt: Which demon becomes able to withstand sunlight by the end of the Swordsmith Village arc?
questions.explanation: Nezuko conquers sunlight at the arc’s climax.

source.title: A Connected Bond: Daybreak and First Light

questions.prompt: What is the name of Tanjiro’s sword-related discovery in the village?
options: A sword more than 300 years old
A sword made of blue crystal
questions.explanation: The village contains a sword said to be over 300 years old.

source.title: A Sword from Over 300 Years Ago

questions.prompt: Which former Hashira initially refuses to participate in Hashira Training?
questions.explanation: Giyu initially separates himself from the Hashira Training program.

questions.prompt: Who explains to Tanjiro why he feels unable to call himself a Hashira?
questions.explanation: Giyu shares his guilt and history with Tanjiro in the second episode.

questions.prompt: Which former Hashira runs the first major endurance stage Tanjiro visits?
questions.explanation: Tengen’s retired compound hosts the early stamina-focused training stage.

source.title: Fully Recovered Tanjiro Joins the Hashira Training

questions.prompt: Which Corps member explicitly says he has eaten demons?
questions.explanation: Genya’s unusual ability to gain power by eating demons is discussed during training.

questions.prompt: Who is the Stone Hashira?
questions.explanation: Gyomei Himejima is the Stone Hashira.

questions.prompt: What does Gyomei make trainees move during his strength training?
questions.explanation: Gyomei’s stage requires trainees to push an enormous rock.

questions.prompt: Which two Hashira are shown patrolling together at the beginning of Hashira Training?
questions.explanation: Sanemi Shinazugawa and Obanai Iguro conduct a joint patrol in the opening episode.

questions.prompt: Who is the Demon Slayer Corps leader who confronts Muzan at the mansion?
questions.explanation: Kagaya meets Muzan at the Ubuyashiki mansion.

questions.prompt: What does Kagaya’s confrontation with Muzan trigger?
questions.explanation: Kagaya’s trap detonates the mansion in the final episode.

questions.prompt: Which Hashira is the author of the eleventh Water Breathing form Dead Calm?
questions.explanation: Giyu created the additional Water Breathing form Dead Calm.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Kanao’s decision-making method before Tanjiro helps her change?
questions.explanation: Kanao relies on a coin flip to make personal decisions.

questions.prompt: Whose fox mask is marked with a scar-like design and worn during training?
questions.explanation: Sabito wears a fox mask bearing the mark associated with Urokodaki’s students.

questions.prompt: What is the relationship between Genya and Sanemi?
questions.explanation: Genya is Sanemi’s younger brother.

questions.prompt: Which demon’s death prompts Muzan to summon the Lower Ranks?
questions.explanation: After Rui’s defeat, Muzan gathers the remaining Lower Ranks.

questions.prompt: What does Shinobu use as the active poison in her anti-demon fighting method?
questions.explanation: Shinobu’s sword and tactics deliver wisteria-based poison to demons.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the dance Tanjiro remembers from his father and later uses in combat?
questions.explanation: Tanjiro’s father’s ceremonial dance is Hinokami Kagura, later used as a combat style.

questions.prompt: What does Nezuko’s Exploding Blood specifically avoid harming?
questions.explanation: Nezuko’s flames burn demon blood and demon techniques without injuring humans.

questions.prompt: Which demon art does Yahaba use in the Asakusa battle?
questions.explanation: Yahaba’s Blood Demon Art creates directional arrows that control movement.

questions.prompt: Which demon art does Susamaru use in that same battle?
questions.explanation: Susamaru attacks with her powerful temari balls.

questions.prompt: Which Lower Rank does Muzan spare and empower after the other Lower Ranks are killed?
questions.explanation: Muzan spares Enmu and grants him more of his blood after killing the other Lower Ranks.

questions.prompt: Which emotional manifestation uses a staff-like weapon and lightning attacks?
questions.explanation: Sekido, the anger manifestation, wields a khakkhara-like staff and produces lightning.

questions.prompt: Which emotional manifestation produces wind by using a fan?
questions.explanation: Karaku, the pleasure manifestation, uses a fan to create powerful gusts.

questions.prompt: Which emotional manifestation has wings and uses sonic attacks?
questions.explanation: Urogi, the joy manifestation, has wings and attacks with sound.

questions.prompt: Which emotional manifestation fights with a spear?
questions.explanation: Aizetsu, the sorrow manifestation, carries a spear.

questions.prompt: What title is held by the demon who plays the biwa and controls the Infinity Castle?
questions.explanation: Nakime becomes Upper Rank Four and controls the Infinity Castle with her biwa.

questions.prompt: Which former Flame Hashira is Rengoku’s father?
questions.explanation: Shinjuro is the retired Flame Hashira and Kyojuro’s father.

source.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba—The Movie: Mugen Train

questions.prompt: What is the name of Rengoku’s younger brother?
questions.explanation: Senjuro Rengoku is Kyojuro’s younger brother.

source.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba—The Movie: Mugen Train

questions.prompt: What rank do Daki and Gyutaro jointly occupy?
questions.explanation: The siblings share the position Upper Rank Six.

questions.prompt: What is the key condition for defeating both Daki and Gyutaro?
options: Both heads must be decapitated at nearly the same time
A Hashira must destroy the obi
questions.explanation: Their shared rank and life force require both siblings to be beheaded together.

questions.prompt: From whom did Tanjiro inherit the hanafuda earrings?
questions.explanation: Tanjiro’s father Tanjuro is shown wearing the earrings before Tanjiro inherits them.
